figurative_meaning_en: An exclamation expressing regret, surprise, or fear
example_sentences_in_bangla: ইয়া আল্লা, এত বড় দুর্ঘটনা হয়েছে!
ইয়া আল্লা, আমি ভুল করে চলে এসেছি।
example_sentences_in_english: Oh God, such a big accident has happened!
Oh Allah, I mistakenly left without telling.
note: Derived from Arabic 'Ya Allah', commonly used in Muslim Bengali communities
